name: Rudman Hall
use: Biological sciences research (Department of Biological Sciences offices at 46 College Road per search excerpt)
style: 1990s brick research building with glazed stair tower, designed to bridge campus styles

facts.text: Ellenzweig's first UNH project, completed 1995 across from Spaulding and designed to bridge the campus's architectural aesthetics; it included a partial renovation of Spaulding.
Dedicated April 30, 1996 to Senator Warren B. Rudman, who secured $15 million in federal funding in 1992, matched by the state.

verdict: Ellenzweig's tidy 1995 brick biology research block with a glazed stair tower.
notes: No licensed photo found. Archives reference photo shows a four-story red-brick block with a glazed, white-framed central stair tower and gabled roof line; tidy 1990s contextual design. No renovations documented; no interior or student evidence found. Old row's "Spaulding swing space 2021" not verified.
